title: 10 Best Ad Intelligence Platforms for 2026: Compared
summary: Compare the best ad intelligence tools by channels, competitive data, creative intelligence, history, limitations, and pricing.
body_markdown:
These ad intelligence tools help paid-media teams **research competitors across search, social, display, video, mobile, and CTV** . We compared advertising intelligence software by channel coverage, competitive and first-party data, freshness, historical depth, geographic reach, workflow, and price.


## Advertising intelligence platforms compared

## 1.[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/ad-intelligence-platform) : best ad intelligence platform for creative-led channels


[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/ad-intelligence-platform) is an ad intelligence platform for enterprises that connects external market research with a company's own advertising and business data. It enables the strongest creative feedback loop for large advertisers that want competitor intelligence, creative-performance analysis, and execution in one workflow.


- **Connected intelligence:** Combines public competitor ads with data from ad accounts, attribution platforms, MMPs, BI tools, warehouses, and internal systems. This lets teams analyze creative attributes against **verified first-party outcomes** instead of relying only on public signals or modeled competitor data.
- **Creative analysis:** Applies standard or custom taxonomies to hooks, messages, offers, CTAs, personas, formats, creators, and visual elements. It supports **frame-level video analysis** , creative deduplication, retention analysis, and fatigue signals.
- **Competitor and market research:** Monitors active and recent ads, messaging changes, offers, formats, channel mix, launch cadence, active days, and creative-based share of voice.
- **Execution workflow:** Findings can become briefs, scripts, new concepts, creative variations, reports, and published ads. Professional and Enterprise plans add capabilities such as Slack, MCP, automated workflows, Figma, DAM, API, SSO, private LLM, and on-premise support.
- **Pricing:** Starter costs **$1,500 per month** . Professional and Enterprise use custom pricing based on ad spend, accounts, data connections, and workflow requirements.


**Limitations:**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/ad-intelligence-platform) is built for enterprises and is **not intended for small businesses** . It does not estimate competitors' total spend, impressions, or reach using media panels or auction proxies.


[Connect competitor and performance intelligence with GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/ad-intelligence-platform) .


## 2. Similarweb: best for web ad spend and publisher intelligence


Similarweb Ad Intelligence analyzes **competitor investment across paid search, display, video, publishers, keywords, creatives, and landing pages** .


- **Core intelligence:** Estimates spend, impressions, visits, publisher activity, share of voice, channel mix, and investment trends.
- **Search and display depth:** Connects paid keywords and search copy with display campaigns, placements, formats, landing pages, and first-seen or last-seen dates.
- **Freshness:** Similarweb says advertising data is calculated daily and published **within 72 hours** .
- **Pricing:** Custom.


**Limitations:** Spend and impression figures represent **tracked-activity estimates, not complete advertiser-account totals** . Similarweb's marketing site presents social coverage, while its Ad Intelligence documentation still marks social advertising as coming soon. Buyers should confirm current social, market, and package availability.


## 3. SpyFu: best Google Ads intelligence tool


SpyFu specializes in **competitor intelligence for Google Search Ads** .


- **Paid-search research:** Shows purchased keywords, ad copy, landing pages, positions, CPC, estimated clicks, keyword overlap, and estimated monthly budgets.
- **Historical intelligence:** Higher plans provide **more than ten years of ad and keyword history** , making SpyFu useful for identifying recurring messages and campaign changes.
- **Data access:** Supports reports, exports, and API access on higher plans.
- **Pricing:** Basic costs $39 per month, or $29 per month when billed annually.


**Limitations:** SpyFu **does not provide comparable paid-social, display, video, or CTV intelligence** . Its budgets and clicks are estimates. SpyFu states that its budget model excludes display advertising and search ads running on other sites.


## 4. Foreplay: best paid social creative intelligence platform


Foreplay combines **paid-social ad discovery, competitor tracking, owned-ad analysis, and creative briefing** .


- **Creative research:** Discovery searches **more than 200 million community-curated ads** by brand, keyword, format, market, status, and creative attribute.
- **Competitor monitoring:** Spyder tracks new launches, active creatives, testing cadence, hooks, landing pages, and changes in competitor libraries.
- **Owned-ad workflow:** Lens connects **Meta and TikTok accounts** for creative analysis and reporting. Teams can save ads, transcribe videos, build boards, and turn references into briefs.
- **Pricing:** Basic costs $59 per month. Workflow costs $175, while Agency costs $459.


**Limitations:** The community-curated database is **not a complete record of every published ad** . Competitor monitoring is concentrated on paid-social creative activity, and connected analytics currently focus on Meta and TikTok. Foreplay does not provide broad competitor spend, publisher, paid-search, display, or CTV intelligence.


## 5. Adyntel: best ad intelligence API


Adyntel provides **structured competitor ad data through an API** rather than a full analysis and reporting platform.


- **Coverage:** Supports **Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and TikTok** . Google data includes available search, display, and YouTube activity.
- **Returned data:** Includes active-ad counts, channel presence, formats, creatives, copy, CTAs, links, and dates.
- **Delivery:** Offers REST API access, JSON results, pagination, webhooks, MCP, bulk data, and integrations with enrichment tools such as Clay.
- **Pricing:** Plans start at **5,000 credits for $44 per month** .


**Limitations:** Adyntel provides observable activity and creative data, **not verified spend or campaign performance** . Teams may need to build their own dashboards, analysis, and alerting workflows around the API.


## 6. Sensor Tower Pathmatics: best omnichannel advertising intelligence platform


Pathmatics gives enterprise teams **a broad view of competitor media investment across digital advertising channels** .


- **Spend and media intelligence:** Estimates spend and impressions by advertiser, brand, category, channel, publisher, geography, creative, and period.
- **Competitive analysis:** Compares share of voice, category position, media allocation, campaign timing, placements, publishers, and creative activity.
- **Coverage:** Includes supported social, display, video, mobile, mobile ad networks, **OTT and CTV** , programmatic, and retail-media channels.
- **Methodology:** Sensor Tower says Pathmatics combines **panel observations with probabilistic web sampling** before modeling spend and impressions.
- **Pricing:** Custom.


**Limitations:** Spend and impression figures are **modeled estimates rather than advertiser-account totals** . Channel, publisher, and geographic coverage varies, so buyers should confirm their required markets and historical depth.


## 7. Minea: best ecommerce ad intelligence tool


Minea combines **social-ad research with ecommerce product and store intelligence** .


- **Ad research:** Searches **Meta and TikTok ads** using product, brand, niche, country, language, format, CTA, activity, and run-duration filters.
- **Creative intelligence:** Includes AI analysis, transcription, related-ad discovery, and image-based search.
- **Ecommerce context:** Connects advertising activity with products, stores, prices, traffic estimates, and revenue signals.
- **Pricing:** Starter costs **$49 per month** , Premium costs $99, and Business costs $199.


**Limitations:** Minea is **designed for ecommerce and dropshipping rather than general advertising intelligence** . It lacks broad paid-search, open-web display, publisher, and CTV coverage. Commercial and engagement metrics should be treated as estimates or research signals.


## 8. AdClarity: best cross-media ad intelligence software


AdClarity provides **self-serve competitor spend and media-mix intelligence across digital channels** , with broader television access on Enterprise.


- **Media intelligence:** Estimates spend, impressions, CPM, share of voice, audiences, publisher activity, and channel allocation.
- **Creative intelligence:** Shows ads, messaging, formats, landing pages, placements, timing, and recurring creative patterns.
- **Coverage and history:** Standard plans cover display, social, and online video in one market. Historical access ranges from three to 12 months. Enterprise adds **52 markets, television intelligence, and data since 2018** .
- **Pricing:** Basic starts at $129 per month, Advanced costs $289, and Team costs $349.


**Limitations:** AdClarity's spend and performance figures are estimates, not verified competitor data. Lower plans restrict markets, channels, history, reports, results, and exports. **CTV, linear television, and full multi-market access require Enterprise** .


## 9. Semrush Advertising Research: best paid search intelligence tool


Semrush Advertising Research examines **competitors' Google Ads keywords, positions, copy, landing pages, and estimated traffic** .


- **Keyword intelligence:** Shows paid keywords, CPC, volume, competition, positions, estimated traffic, and estimated traffic cost.
- **Competitor analysis:** Identifies domains bidding on overlapping terms and tracks new, lost, improving, or declining paid-keyword positions.
- **Historical data:** Semrush databases extend back to **2012** .
- **Pricing:** Advertising Base costs **$99 per month** when billed annually. Pro costs $220 and adds AdClarity data for display, video, or social ads.


**Limitations:** Advertising Research itself **focuses on Google paid search** . Semrush calculates estimates using a domain's positions among the top eight paid ads for keywords in its database. Local, time-sensitive, audience-targeted, and uncatalogued ads can be missed.


## 10. BigSpy: best multi-network ad intelligence tool


BigSpy provides **broad creative-search coverage across 11 social, search, video, ecommerce, and mobile-ad networks** .


- **Database:** BigSpy reports **more than one billion creatives** from nearly ten million advertisers across more than 80 countries and 26 languages.
- **Creative research:** Filters ads by advertiser, keyword, URL, country, language, industry, format, launch date, duration, audience, and available engagement signals.
- **Competitor tracking:** Saves selected ads and follows changes in creatives, copy, promotions, and launch activity.
- **Pricing:** A free plan includes limited Facebook searches. Paid plans start at **$69 per month** .


**Limitations:** BigSpy is primarily a creative-search and monitoring database. It **does not provide verified budgets, first-party creative-performance analysis, or complete media allocation** . Network access, advanced analysis, and download limits vary by plan.


## How to choose an ad intelligence tool


The best advertising intelligence software depends on the **channels, data, and decisions your team needs to support** .


- **Paid channels:** Confirm support for every required network, market, format, and device. Platform-level coverage does not guarantee equal data in every country.
- **Competitive or first-party data:** Some advertising intelligence tools analyze public competitor activity or estimate spend. Others connect to owned ad accounts and business data for verified performance analysis.
- **Intelligence type:** Choose between creative, keyword, publisher, placement, spend, product, or connected performance intelligence.
- **History and freshness:** Compare archive depth, update frequency, first-seen and last-seen data, and the delay before new ads appear.
- **Geographic coverage:** Verify the available advertisers, publishers, channels, and metrics in every required market.
- **Workflow:** Review exports, APIs, alerts, saved searches, reporting, permissions, integrations, and whether insights can become briefs or new ads.
- **Pricing:** Check which markets, channels, history, exports, seats, and integrations are included. A low starting price may cover only a limited part of the advertised platform.
